summary.text: Duwayne Collier, a Green Party candidate who defeated Jon Robert Ralston in the July 21, 2026 Green primary, lost the November 3, 2026 election for secretary of state of Arizona to Adrian Fontes.
He received 1.5% of the vote to Adrian Fontes's 54.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Little else about his background or platform was found.

sources.title: Secretary of State of Arizona results 2026
